newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN MONEY RATES RISE ON FUND SHORTAGE.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN MONEY RATES RISE ON FUND SHORTAGE.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates rose on Thursday amid a shortage of funds, but dealers said the rates would ease on Friday on an inflow of about 1.5 billion rupees following the maturity of short-term federal bonds.

"Overnight rates opened on a firm note due to a shortage of funds in the system," a dealer said. "Early deals were struck at 15 percent. Later rates rose to around 17 percent, but towards the close they ended at around 14 percent."
